canada.title: Ottawa to study Divorce Act reform to address family violence
canada.summary: The federal government says it’s launching a study of ways to strengthen the Divorce Act, one day after critics condemned its handling of a private member’s bill that sought to curb parental alienation claims.

canada.summary: OTTAWA - Canada-U.S. Trade Minister Dominic LeBlanc is set to hold the first meeting of an advisory committee on bilateral economic relations since the midterm elections that delivered a sharp rebuke of the Trump administration.

canada.summary: Five teenagers have been arrested after a boy was allegedly assaulted at a skate park in Mission, B.C., last month.

canada.title: Norwegian Cruise Line making 17 fewer stops in Halifax next year
canada.summary: Norwegian Cruise Line says in response to guest feedback, it is dropping a Halifax stop from its seven-day round trip starting in Boston, opting to spend an extra day in Bermuda.

canada.title: Montreal byelections crucial for rebuilding NDP, party leader Avi Lewis says
canada.summary: Avi Lewis said a win in either Montreal byelection would be "incredible" but he sees these contests — and the four others taking place across Canada on Dec. 7 — as a means to continue building up the NDP's support base for the next general election.

canada.title: Fire in downtown Moncton closes streets surrounding restaurant
canada.summary: A fire in a house and restaurant in downtown Moncton forced the closure of surrounding streets on Thursday morning as firefighters battled the flames.

canada.title: Medicine Hat releases review of suspected drowning of child at regional park
canada.summary: The City of Medicine Hat has released the findings of an independent review into the suspected drowning of an 11-year-old child during a field trip to Echo Dale Regional Park in June.

canada.title: PAL Airlines pilots are voting on whether to go on strike — potentially stopping flights next month
canada.summary: After failed negotiations with their employer, PAL Airlines pilots are participating in a strike authorization vote — potentially stopping flights next month.

canada.title: Language issues continue to dog Quebec accused murderer’s court appearances in N.L.
canada.summary: A Quebec man accused of first-degree murder in Happy Valley-Goose Bay, N.L., continues to experience problems after electing to have his case tried in French, including a Crown prosecutor not comfortable speaking “legal French,” and issues with members in the courtroom being able to understand an interpreter.

canada.title: New designer drug found in Toronto fentanyl supply
canada.summary: A new opioid part of an emerging class of designer drugs has been found in fentanyl samples in Toronto, according to a drug monitoring program.

canada.title: Anthropic needs rapid growth to keep up spending, as Canadian AI sector heats up
canada.summary: Anthropic's investor documents warn the company needs to increase sales to pay for its data centre leases and infrastructure. At the same time, the company says it needs to plan its data centre investments years in advance, without knowing whether its customers will be there for the long term.

canada.title: Former top Mountie to be sentenced for assault on teen in B.C. court

canada.title: Winnipeggers book their tickets to Vice City with the launch of Grand Theft Auto VI
canada.summary: Lee Stewart and all his staff are taking a vacation from the chilly autumn streets of Winnipeg and heading for the sunny coast of Vice City, the fictitious setting of the latest Rockstar Games release, Grand Theft Auto VI. They're far from alone.
